name: Runpod
summary: Serverless GPU compute platform. Rent high-end NVIDIA GPUs by the hour to train and deploy your own machine learning models.
best_for: developers and ML teams that want cheap, per-second GPU compute for inference and experiments without committing to hyperscaler contracts
skip_if: you need enterprise SLAs, compliance guarantees and managed everything (hyperscalers exist for that), or your workload is steady enough that owned/reserved hardware wins
honest_knock: The honest math is utilization. H100 serverless at $5.89/hr is 2.04 times the $2.89/hr Secure Cloud H100 PCIe pod rate. A100 serverless at $2.99/hr is 1.43 times the $2.09/hr Secure Cloud A100 PCIe pod rate. That is brilliant for spiky inference and wasteful for steady training, so pick the mode per workload, not per habit. And like all GPU clouds, the meter never sleeps: an idle pod you forgot is the cloud version of the subscription graveyard. Set spend alerts before the first experiment, not after the first invoice.

pricing.notes: Pay-per-use GPU cloud. As of 27 November 2026, Secure Cloud pods range from $0.27/hr for RTX A5000 to $10.49/hr for B300. L4 is $0.69/hr, H100 PCIe $2.89/hr, H100 SXM $4.39/hr, H200 $5.29/hr, B200 $8.99/hr and A100 PCIe $2.09/hr. Community and Secure hourly pod rates are $0.34 and $0.89 for RTX 4090, $0.22 and $0.50 for RTX 3090, $0.33 and $0.69 for RTX A6000, $1.99 and $2.89 for H100 PCIe, and $2.69 and $4.39 for H100 SXM. Serverless workers range from $0.58/hr for the 16GB tier to $13.99/hr for B300, with A100 at $2.99/hr and H100 at $5.89/hr. On-demand cluster rates per GPU-hour are $2.15 for A100 SXM, $4.79 for H100 SXM, $6.35 for H200 SXM, $9.59 for B200 and $10.79 for B300. L40S and reserved clusters require a quote. Storage is billed on top and is easy to miss: container disk $0.10/GB/month, volume disk $0.10 while running and $0.20 while idle, network storage $0.07/GB under 1TB and $0.05 over it, $0.14 for the high-performance tier. Our 27 November 2026 reading found three rates higher than on 24 November: the B200 pod at $8.99 an hour on Secure Cloud (was $7.99), the B300 pod at $10.49 (was $8.99) and the B300 serverless worker at $13.99 (was $11.99). Every other rate in this text read the same.
